archetypes.name: dyn-review-runlog
archetypes.rationale: Step 4 review logging now depends on a shared RUN_ID slug guard and log root.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed /review Step 4 prompt for log-root and RUN_ID guard correctness. Verify the hoisted review_log_root is available to all review log-phase, transcript capture, and commit calls. Confirm the slug predicate matches run_log_batch.validate_run_id_slug and preserves nested review ownership. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
